corrections.reason: Two choices repeat the same service-isolation benefit, and the other choices also describe plausible benefits of microservices. This NOT question has no defensible single answer.
The source marks a valid Java lambda as incorrect. The brace-wrapped parameter list and bare return in choice C are not valid Java lambda syntax.
The last answer choice lost the UML stereotype text during PDF extraction and appears only as two empty angle-bracket pairs. It cannot be scored accurately from the available choices.

Certification improves assurance but cannot guarantee that an organization will never suffer an information security incident. The source marks a five-year validity claim that is inconsistent with the reviewer question.
SSL/TLS secures application traffic over the transport layer; it does not run in the OSI network layer. HTTPS is HTTP carried over TLS, so the marked HTTPS description is not the incorrect one here.
A compromised hypervisor can affect multiple hosted operating systems. That is a virtualization vulnerability, not specifically an insecure API.
An NFT is non-fungible: tokens of the same collection are not necessarily interchangeable or equal in value. The red source mark points to the definition of a non-fungible token.

A data lake holds varied source data for broad future use. The marked single repository description is plausible, while more than one other choice describes task-specific or already transformed data. This NOT item needs a clearer key.
Critical Chain Method is a project scheduling approach. BPR, Process Innovation, and TQM are business process improvement approaches, so the source mark on Process Innovation is inconsistent.
The source figure plots expectations against time through a peak and trough. That is Gartner’s Hype Cycle, not the four-quadrant Magic Quadrant.
Both examples name the outcome the projects aim to achieve: product lifecycle management and faster integrated decisions. They illustrate defined objectives, not the gradual refinement of a plan.
This is a request for information: it gathers supplier capabilities before a detailed proposal or project order. The source marked RFP.

The description mixes distribution, correlation, and outlier language. The available choices do not contain a clear single chart that satisfies every part; the red Bar Chart mark is unsupported. Study only.
Using the usual PERT three-point estimate, (optimistic + 4 × most likely + pessimistic) ÷ 6 = (8 + 40 + 18) ÷ 6 = 11 million. The source marks 10 million.
Classifying problems, finding causes, and prioritizing causes are activities in the Analyze underlying causes phase, not implementation and feedback.
